python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in open('answers.jsonl')]
rows[29]['errors'].append('missing_mark')
rows[52]['detail']=''
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(cards)==len(rows)==56
assert [c['card_id'] for c in cards]==[r['card_id'] for r in rows]
assert len(set(r['card_id'] for r in rows))==len(rows)
for r in rows:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where','segmentation_detail'])<=r.keys()
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
for field in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:
 print(field,dict(collections.Counter(r[field] for r in rows)))
print('errors',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common())
print('Count, order, unique IDs, and required fields verified:',len(rows))
